messages:
Jared: FYI partner field team hit a blocker on AcmeHealth private deploy — image boots but agent fails loading nvme driver and GPU drops, inference container exits. Need an architecture/implementation triage ASAP.
Priya: Ugh. Can you paste the kernel/dmesg snippet and the agent log?
Tomas: Attaching short snippet from node-3 dmesg: ```[  123.456789] nvme 3: failed to load nvme_core.ko: -2
[  123.457000] nvidia: probe of GPU0 failed with -517``` Uploading full logs to the partner ticket now.
Sienna: Is there a quick mitigation so their prod traffic doesn't hit errors? Can we route that tenant to hosted inference while we fix the node?
Megan: We can, but need partner approval for data-plane change (PII routing). If they approve, we can set a policy to route their workspace -> hosted model group for reads only.
FieldOps-Bot: Deploy alert: private-deploy-acmehealth v1.3 failed on node-3 nvme-driver-step (incident INC-5421) — auto-fallthrough NOT triggered.
Priya: My read: looks like an initramfs / module mismatch. Two options: 1) kernel rollback/patch to 5.10.142 where module resolves, or 2) load our fallback module `redwood-gpu-fallback` and blackhole the failing NVMe driver. Need field eng to test option 2.
Tomas: Scheduling a 9:00am PT architecture + field-eng quick sync with AcmeHealth ops and partner SI. I'll create the invite and attach the logs + the short runbook for fallback.
Jared: Also add a quick marketplace image sanity check — partner image had an extra initramfs layer which likely caused module mismatch. Can someone verify signing and files in image?
Megan: Running verification: `cosign verify --key /keys/marketplace-prod.pub acme-image:v1.3` -> PASS for image signature, but initramfs contents differ from our baseline (extra `init.d/99-acme-quirk`). Asking partner to rebuild without that. Link to runbook: https://redwood.dev/runbooks/marketplace-image-guidelines
Sienna: OK. If field-eng can't validate kernel patch by EOD, fallback to hosted route to preserve SLA. Please prep the routing change and the privacy consent note. :warning:
Priya: Tagging @Tomas oncall for followthrough. Requesting `/var/log/redwood/agent.log` + `sudo dmesg -T | tail -n 200` + `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=utilization.gpu --format=csv` from node-3.
Tomas: Got it. Pulling logs now and will upload. I'll confirm whether fallback module loads cleanly on a staging node before touching prod.
Jared: Thanks. Keep updates in this thread — this will be canonical for the SI delivery stitches and go-live decisions. :thumbsup:
